THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LICHTI, CHRISTOPHER CARL LICHTI, RINKU RATHAUD RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WEI, FRANCES SARMIENTO, RAMIRO $3,700.00 PRINCIPAL, $172.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,872.50, (SEE ATTACHED)----- PLAINTIFFS TERMINATED THEIR ONE YEAR LEASE EARLY BY GIVING LESS THAN 30 DAYS' NOTICE OF THEIR INTENT TO VACATE. PLAINTIFFS GAVE DEFENDANTS NOTICE OF THEIR INTENT TO VACATE ON JULY 28, 2015 AND VACATED THE RESIDENCE ON AUGUST 4, 2015. PLAINTIFFS DID NOT PAY ANY PORTION OF THE RENT FOR AUGUST, SEPTEMBER OR OCTOBER 2015. DEFENDANTS OBTAINED NEW TENANTS WHO MOVED IN THE RESIDENTCE ON OCTOBER 22, 2015. DEFENDANTS DID NOT RETURN PLAINTIFFS SECURITY DEPOSIT ($3,700.00) WITHIN 21 DAYS AS REQUIRED BY CIVIL CODE SECTION 1950.5. THE COURT FINDS THAT DEFENDANTS DID NOT ACT IN BAD FAITH IN NOT RETURNING THE SECURITY DEPOSIT AND, THEREFORE PLAINTIFFS ARE NOT ENTITLED TO STATUTORY DAMAGES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT WEI, FRANCES SARMIENTO, RAMIRO RECOVER FROM CROSS DEFENDANT LICHTI, CHRISTOPHER CARL LICHTI, RINKU RATHAUD $6,289.00 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,394.00, SEE ATTACHED) DEFENDANTS ARE ENTITLED TO DAMAGES RESULTING FORM PLAINTIFFS EARLY TERMINATION OF THEIR ONE YEAR LEASE. THE COURT FINDS THE DEFENDANT ACTED IN GOOD FAITH TO MITIGATE THEIR DAMAGES RESULTING FROM PLAINTIFFS EARLY TERMINATION OF THE LEASE AND THAT THEY ARE ENTITLED TO DAMAGES FOR THE UPAID RENT FOR THE MONTHS OF AUGUST, SEPTEMBER AND OCTOBER (PARTIAL), 2015. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS

ORDER ON (SC-108) -FILED BY PLAINTIFF- REQUEST TO CORRECT OR CANCEL JUDGMENT (SMALL CLAIMS). THE REQUEST IS DENIED. EXPLANATION FOR DECISION: CCP 116.725 PERMITS A MOTION TO (1) CORRECT A CLERICAL ERROR IN A JUDGMENT & (2) VACATE A JUDGMENT WHEN IT IS BASED ON AN INCORRECT OR ERRONEOUS LEGAL BASIS. NEITHER IS PRESENT HERE. IF THE PARTIES HAVE AGREED TO AN ALTERNATE SETTLEMENT THEY MAY FILE SATISFACTIONS OF JUDGMENT PER CCP 116.850.
